Title: TOM: Q: VtES: Sabbat Threat and the Edge.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
During your untap, when you have the Edge and one or two Sabbat Threat
counters, can you:

1) Gain 1 pool for the Edge.
2) Sacrifice the Edge to lose all threat counters

And be done with it, never having dealth with the 'lose one pool for each
threat counter', or do you have to order all of the effects at the start of
the phase, regardless of how things change during the phase?

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
L. Scott Johnson <sjoh...@math.scarolina.edu> wrote:
>During your untap, when you have the Edge and one or two Sabbat Threat
> counters, can you:
>
> 1) Gain 1 pool for the Edge.
> 2) Sacrifice the Edge to lose all threat counters
>
>And be done with it, never having dealth with the 'lose one pool for each
>threat counter', or do you have to order all of the effects at the start of
>the phase, regardless of how things change during the phase?

You don't order everything all at once and then do them all at once,
so you could do 1) and 2) as described, with a net gain of 1 pool, yes.
